messages:
eli: Postmortem follow-up: last-night's cross-region retry burst. Short summary: long-tail TLS handshakes + aggressive client SDK retries exhausted conntrack and caused route churn. Need owners, short timelines, and automated detection.

maria: I'll take routing debounce and a prefix-cache sanity check. Plan: 200ms debounce default, emit metrics `route.debounce.count` and `route.debounce.ms`. Due: 2026-03-29.

dinesh: I'll own conntrack mitigation. Immediate action: bump conntrack table size and GC threshold, canary 5%->50%->100% today. Followup: capacity test with k6 long-tail profile. Hotfix due today.

raj: I'll own TLS fallback behavior. Add explicit fallback to TLS1.2 when TLS1.3 negotiation fails with ECDHE errors, and alert on fallback >0.1%. Canary rotation tomorrow.

clare: I'll coordinate rollouts and document rollback cmd knobs. Adding Duo alerts: TLS handshake err rate >0.4%, conntrack occupancy >80%. Rollout window Fri AM.

ops_oncall: Relevant logs:
```
[2026-03-28T23:07:12Z] LB tls: handshake timeout client=10.4.5.6
[2026-03-28T23:07:12Z] conntrack: insert failed: table full id=54321
[2026-03-28T23:07:13Z] route: rapid updates for service=edge-api region=ap-southeast-1
```
Also added pcap playbook: https://confluence.redwood/incident/playbooks/pcap-capture and tagged node group: lb-ap-southeast-1-prod

deploy-bot: dinesh/conntrack-hotfix PR CI passed. Deploy started by clare. ETA ~18m. :rocket:

eli: Ops - please add scheduled query to flag cross-region retry spikes (10m window) and post weekly digest to #incidents-weekly. Also annotate postmortem with the thresholds.

ops_oncall: Added scheduled query `cross_region.retry_spike` every 15m -> posts digest. Annotated postmortem and created Grafana alert group.

maria: I'll add smoke test that calls randomized prefixes during debounce rollout to ensure streaming latencies stay within SLO.

dinesh: After hotfix, will post k6 artifacts here.

raj: Opening TLS fallback PR and contacting CDN partner about cipher mismatches.

clare: Tracker (I'm owning): https://go.redwood/issue/INC-4820

eli: Thanks team. We'll review statuses in Monday retro. Reopen thread if regressions appear. :white_check_mark:
